title: GET DATABASE MEASURES
featured_technology: 4D engine internal performance counters (memory, disk I/O, queries, sorts)

historical_commentary.text: GET DATABASE MEASURES exposes low-level 4D engine performance counters; it's a stable, still-supported diagnostic command, though modern 4D developers increasingly reach for the newer, higher-level SQL/ORDA-aware performance tooling and 4D's improved built-in monitoring rather than parsing this command's raw output by hand.
related_updates: 4D's newer built-in performance/monitoring tools in later versions supplement this low-level command
